DavidAU, the maintainer, developed it with contributions from Nightmedia and other undisclosed fine-tunes. sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B · LLM Releases
sources.snippet: The open-weight, single-GPU sibling of Qwen3.8-Max, published by Alibaba on Hugging Face on Aug 14 2026 under Apache 2.0 — the smaller open release Alibaba had promised alongside the closed Qwen3.8-Max flagship. A 27B dense model (~28B counting the ~1B vision encoder) with 64 layers, hidden size 5,120, and a 248,320-token vocabulary.
